propositions: CLI --timeout and --timeout-method flags on _build-and-test.yml's shared-tier lanes permanently shadow ini-based budget changes carried in patchsets, preventing verified test runs of timeout fixes

pytest-timeout precedence (CLI > env > ini) combined with trusted-main workflow execution creates a bug where a patchset modifying the ini budget cannot exercise its own change in Verified because the workflow file comes from main
The conftest-floor hardening approach (pytest-timeout's config._env_timeout resolved read-only at session start) has no supported hook point and no OSS precedent, making it unviable

Removing --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread flags from both shared-tier lanes and relying on identical values in [tool.pytest.ini_options] at pyproject.toml preserves effective budget while enabling patchset-driven ini changes to be self-tested
The eleven other calibrated CI pytest lanes outside _build-and-test.yml retain their explicit --timeout flags and must continue to use the thread method
Single-sourcing authority to the ini aligns with ecosystem standard practice (scikit-learn, pandas, numpy pass no --timeout on CI command lines)
